item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President assigns the Coordinator oversight and directs agencies to prioritize discretionary PGII support and investments, subject to law and appropriations; any project-level consequences arise later through agency implementation.","evidence":"Agencies shall, consistent with applicable law and available appropriations, prioritize support for the PGII and make strategic investments"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"Executive officials must report, prioritize programming, and establish coordination mechanisms; these are internal planning and discretionary implementation duties, not dictated legal outcomes.","evidence":"shall submit a report to the President within 180 days of the date of this memorandum"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The named Secretaries must develop an internal strategy for identifying and referring projects for later agency consideration, without requiring approval or another legal consequence.","evidence":"shall develop a strategy for using Embassy Deal Teams to identify potential priority infrastructure projects"},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"The Secretary of State must coordinate diplomatic engagements and lead interagency standard-setting efforts, which are coordination and policy-management functions without a presently imposed legal consequence.","evidence":"shall lead interagency efforts regarding international coordination on infrastructure development standards and metrics"},{"segment_id":"5","code":1,"rationale":"The Secretary of Commerce must develop and implement a promotional strategy, but the segment does not mandate contracts, funding, eligibility, or another specified legal result.","evidence":"shall develop and implement a strategy to boost the competitiveness of the United States"},{"segment_id":"6","code":1,"rationale":"The Treasury Secretary must develop and implement an investment-support strategy; the means and any later transactions remain discretionary.","evidence":"shall develop and implement a strategy to catalyze private-sector investment"},{"segment_id":"7","code":1,"rationale":"The Treasury Secretary must prepare an engagement plan intended to encourage investment, an internal planning assignment that does not itself or necessarily later impose a legal consequence.","evidence":"shall develop a plan for engaging the MDBs"},{"segment_id":"8","code":1,"rationale":"The referenced Treasury actor must coordinate with partners while executing the plan, a discretionary implementation and coordination duty without a specified legal outcome.","evidence":"shall coordinate with like-minded partners in the plan's execution"},{"segment_id":"9","code":1,"rationale":"The DFC CEO is encouraged, rather than required, to develop an engagement plan; this is discretionary planning with no prescribed legal consequence.","evidence":"is encouraged to develop a plan to enhance engagement"},{"segment_id":"10","code":1,"rationale":"The Transportation Secretary must develop and implement a strategy and launch a best-practices toolkit, which directs programmatic implementation without dictating funding, contracting, or regulatory outcomes.","evidence":"shall develop and implement a strategy to promote high-quality, sustainable, and resilient transportation infrastructure"},{"segment_id":"11","code":1,"rationale":"The APNSA must identify possible actions and conduct reviews, while the remaining provisions define internal scope and preserve existing authority; none presently changes substantive rights or dictates a later legal outcome.","evidence":"shall lead biannual reviews to monitor the progress, metrics, and outcomes of the PGII's investments and projects"}]}
